message.mundos_de_axelis.portal_locked: La piedra no reacciona: antes debes vencer al jefe anterior.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.portal_stone_fo: Clic derecho: lleva a ti y a quienes estén cerca a la arena del Rey Brote.
El jefe de la etapa 1 suelta el Sello de la Naturaleza.
message.mundos_de_axelis.grapple_miss: Nothing within reach of the grapple.
Crunchy, sweet, with a hidden message.
Eating it brings a little luck.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.star_feather.1: Right click: launches you into the sky.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.star_feather.2: Then you float down among the stars.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.star_magnet.1: Right click: pulls nearby dropped items to you.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.confetti_cannon: Whoever it catches glows for a while.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.rainbow_grapple: Right click: shoots a colorful thread and pulls you there.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.bubble_pearl.1: Right click: wraps you in a bubble.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.bubble_pearl.2: Breathe underwater, swim fast, fall softly.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.pocket_backpack: Right click: opens your backpack (27 slots).
What you store travels with you, inside the item.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.heart_locket.1: Hold right click: takes you to your bed or spawn.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.heart_locket.2: Home is where the heart is.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.firefly_lantern: In hand, fireflies surround you and you see in the dark.
Right click: turn on or off.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.star_clock.1: Right click at night: time runs until dawn.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.star_clock.2: Everyone in the world sees the sun rise.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.flower_wand.1: Right click the ground: crops grow and flowers bloom.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.flower_wand.2: A wave of petals sweeps the place.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.umbrella.1: Hold right click in the air: glide where you look.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.umbrella.2: No fall damage while you use it.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.explorer_compas: Right click: points to the nearest structure.
Sneak + right click: change what it looks for.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.lucky_die.1: Right click: roll it and let luck decide.
message.mundos_de_axelis.clock_day: It's still day. The clock waits for night.
message.mundos_de_axelis.die_1: A %s... bad luck. You move slowly.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.watcher_eye.1: Right click: a wave of light reveals nearby monsters.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.watcher_eye.2: You'll see them glow through walls.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.cocoa_flask.1: Hold right click to drink: heals, feeds and gives absorption.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.cocoa_flask.2: Five sips of something very warm.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.calm_bell.1: Right click: its chime soothes nearby monsters.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.calm_bell.2: They get slow and lose the will to fight.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.rainbow_brush.1: Right click wool, concrete, glass, terracotta or carpet: next color.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.rainbow_brush.2: Sneaking: paints the whole connected set.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.blink_stone.1: Right click: teleport toward where you look.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.rainbow_lollipo: Sweet and quick: speed and fast mining for a while.
Eaten in the blink of an eye.
message.mundos_de_axelis.flask_full: You don't need a drink right now.
message.mundos_de_axelis.brush_none: The brush doesn't work on this block.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.phoenix_ring.1: Fire immunity. If you would die, you are reborn in flames with full health and absorption (every 3 min).
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.feather_talisma: No fall damage. Sneak in the air to fall like a feather.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.oak_heart.1: Now and then wraps you in protective bark.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.oak_heart.2: R key: sap that restores health and hunger.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.miner_medallion: R key: sonar that marks nearby ores.
The rock whispers where it shines.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.tide_shell.1: In water: breathe, swim fast and see clearly.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.tide_shell.lore: You can hear the sea if you listen.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.wolf_fang.1: Fast at night. Stronger when hurt. Heal when defeating enemies.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.wolf_fang.2: R key: howl that empowers you and your wolves.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.star_charm.1: Constant luck: better loot and fishing.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.star_charm.2: R key: star shower that drops experience.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.star_charm.lore: Make a wish, Odette and Axelis.
Freezes the water under your feet as you walk. Puts out fire.
R key: frost wave that slows enemies.
message.mundos_de_axelis.phoenix_reborn: You have risen from the ashes!
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.sun_crown.1: Under the daytime sun: regeneration and strength.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.sun_crown.2: R key: solar flare that burns and repels enemies.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.sun_crown.lore: A sunrise that fits in your hand.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.storm_eye.1: In rain or thunder: speed and resistance.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.storm_eye.2: R key: lightning strikes where you look.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.wind_ring.2: R key: a gust that launches you forward.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.wind_ring.lore: Runs faster than its own echo.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.dragon_scale.2: R key: cone of dragon breath.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.moon_crystal.1: At night: see in the dark and recover.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.moon_crystal.2: R key: gravity pulse that lifts enemies.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.eternal_rose.1: Gently heals nearby players and pets.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.eternal_rose.2: R key: bloom that heals everyone nearby.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.eternal_rose.lo: It never wilts, like Odette and Axelis.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.hourglass.2: R key: time stops; enemies barely move.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.fox_charm.2: R key: smoke bomb, invisibility and confused monsters.
message.mundos_de_axelis.storm_miss: Nowhere for the lightning to strike.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.crystal_heart.1: Regrows a crystal shield every 20 s.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.crystal_heart.2: R key: barrier that protects you and repels enemies.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.specter_mask.2: R key: mist form (invisible, fast and resistant).
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.specter_mask.lo: No one remembers seeing it pass.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.aurora_horn.2: R key: grants strength, speed and regeneration to allies and pushes enemies away.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.arcane_tome.1: With experience, you sometimes see in the dark.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.arcane_tome.2: R key: magic missiles that seek enemies.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.warrior_medal.1: When hit you grow furious: strength and speed.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.warrior_medal.2: R key: war cry that empowers allies.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.vampire_chalice: R key: blood nova that hurts enemies and heals you.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.ender_orb.1: In The End: resistance and regeneration.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.ender_orb.2: R key: swap places with what you look at.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.ender_orb.lore: A little piece of another world.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.titan_belt.1: Tough skin: resistance when your health is below 75%.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.titan_belt.2: R key: seismic slam that damages and launches into the air.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.titan_belt.lore: The earth trembles at your step.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.voltaic_scepter: Con lluvia o tormenta: velocidad y prisa.
Mantén el clic derecho para cargar y suelta: un rayo salta entre enemigos.
Guarda el trueno de una tormenta que nunca terminó.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.war_horn.1: Con 2 o más enemigos cerca: fuerza.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.war_horn.2: Mantén el clic derecho para soplar: onda de choque que debilita enemigos y fortalece aliados.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.war_horn.lore: Su sonido se oye antes de que llegue el amanecer.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.home_mirror.2: Mantén el clic derecho 3 segundos quieto: te lleva a tu cama o al inicio del mundo.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.home_mirror.lor: Siempre muestra el lugar donde alguien te espera.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.medusa_eye.1: Agachado y quieto: piel de piedra.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.medusa_eye.2: R key: los enemigos frente a ti se vuelven piedra y no pueden moverse.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.medusa_eye.lore: No lo mires directamente… o sí.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.rage_gauntlet.1: Cada golpe suma furia: más fuerza y velocidad.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.rage_gauntlet.2: R key: puñetazo contra el suelo que gasta la furia (mínimo 3).
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.rage_gauntlet.l: Cuanto más golpeas, más caliente se pone.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.umbral_glaive.1: En la oscuridad: velocidad y fuerza.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.umbral_glaive.2: R key: seis hojas de sombra giran y cazan enemigos.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.magma_boots.1: Inmune al fuego y a la lava; caminas sobre ella.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.magma_boots.2: R key: salto volcánico que explota al caer.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.cloud_bottle.2: R key: impulso al cielo, también en el aire.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.cloud_bottle.lo: Una nube pequeña que quiere escaparse.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.void_singularit: Atrae los objetos del suelo (agáchate para apagarlo).
R key: agujero negro que arrastra enemigos y luego implosiona.
Un punto donde todo termina… y empieza.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.celestial_aegis: Genera un escudo de absorción cada 10 segundos.
R key: cúpula de luz que absorbe los próximos 5 golpes.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.healing_lyre.1: Con otra persona cerca: ambos regeneran.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.healing_lyre.2: Mantén el clic derecho para tocar: cura a quien esté cerca.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.genie_lamp.2: R key: un genio de humo cumple un deseo al azar.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.genie_lamp.lore: Solo concede un deseo a la vez, pero no es avaro.
De noche, bajo el cielo: fuerza.
R key: marca el lugar y llueven meteoros.
Las estrellas fugaces no piden permiso.
R key: te teletransportas tras el enemigo y lo cortas tres veces.
El sol se apaga un instante, y ya está hecho.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.quake_seal.2: R key: ondas de temblor que lanzan por los aires a los enemigos.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.light_wings.1: Cuando caes rápido, se abren y frenan la caída.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.light_wings.2: R key: vuelo corto con alas doradas.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.soul_lantern.1: Guarda las almas de lo que derrotas; con 5, velocidad.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.soul_lantern.2: R key: lanza las almas como espíritus que persiguen enemigos y te curan.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.soul_lantern.lo: Su luz nunca se apaga, pero tampoco es cálida.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.prism_rainbow.1: De día al aire libre: suerte.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.prism_rainbow.2: Mantén el clic derecho: rayo de arcoíris que abrasa lo que apuntes.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.prism_rainbow.l: Toda la luz cabe en un cristal.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.solar_chakram.2: R key: lanzas un disco de fuego que vuelve a tu mano.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.time_pendulum.2: R key: detiene a los enemigos y proyectiles a tu alrededor por 5 segundos.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.time_pendulum.l: Un segundo robado vale más que mil.
msg.mundos_de_axelis.no_target: No hay nadie a quien apuntar.
msg.mundos_de_axelis.genie.2: ¡Deseo: ver en la oscuridad y respirar bajo el agua!
message.mundos_de_axelis.rewind_none: You don't remember any moment yet. Wait a few seconds.
message.mundos_de_axelis.red_thread_none: Nobody close enough to tie the thread.
message.mundos_de_axelis.red_thread_busy: That person already has a thread tied.
message.mundos_de_axelis.rocket_empty: Out of fuel. Land to recharge.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.star_bow.1: De noche bajo el cielo: visión nocturna y suerte.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.star_bow.2: Mantén el clic derecho para tensar y suelta: estrellas teledirigidas que dibujan una constelación.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.star_bow.lore: Cada flecha es una estrella que todavía no se ha apagado.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.comet_lance.1: Al correr: velocidad y rastro de cometa.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.comet_lance.2: Mantén el clic derecho para cargar y suelta: embistes en línea recta como un cometa.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.comet_lance.lor: No pide permiso a las estrellas para cruzar el cielo.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.mirror_shield.1: Con la mitad de vida o menos: resistencia.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.mirror_shield.2: Mantén el clic derecho: refleja proyectiles, reduce el daño y devuelve el golpe.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.mirror_shield.l: Muestra al enemigo lo que lleva dentro.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.astral_spyglass: Los enemigos que golpeas brillan unos segundos.
Mantén el clic derecho para mirar lejos: marca enemigos y recibirán más daño.
Las constelaciones también te miran a ti.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.fang_staff.2: R key: mandíbulas espectrales muerden en línea; agachado, en círculo.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.fang_staff.lore: Antes de que lo notes, ya te ha mordido la sombra.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.rewind_anchor.1: Recuerda dónde y cómo estabas hace unos segundos.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.rewind_anchor.2: R key: vuelves a donde estabas hace 6 segundos, con la vida que tenías.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.rewind_anchor.l: Hay errores que el tiempo está dispuesto a perdonar.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.fate_coin.1: A veces deja caer una pepita de oro a tus pies.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.fate_coin.2: R key: lanzas la moneda. Cara, fortuna para todos; cruz, tormenta para los enemigos.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.fate_coin.lore: Las dos caras sonríen. Solo una muerde.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.heart_fireworks: Con otra persona cerca: ambos reciben absorción.
Mantén el clic derecho y suelta: tres cohetes que estallan en corazones y estrellas.
Para celebrar que estáis aquí, juntos.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.red_thread.1: Con otra persona cerca: velocidad, y un hilo rojo os une.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.red_thread.2: R key: atas un hilo a quien tengas cerca; mientras estéis juntos os dais velocidad, os curáis y compartís los golpes.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.red_thread.lore: Se puede estirar, enredar... pero nunca romper.
Con aliados a menos de 12 bloques: fuerza.
R key: clavas un estandarte; los aliados cerca ganan fuerza, resistencia y regeneración.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.whirlwind_staff: Desvía los proyectiles que se acercan.
R key: un torbellino avanza, levanta enemigos y los lanza por los aires.
El viento siempre sabe a quién empujar.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.world_tree_seed: De día al aire libre: regeneración lenta.
Mantén el clic derecho para plantarla: un árbol de luz cura a los aliados y hace brotar flores.
De aquí nacieron todos los mundos.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.hatchling_egg.1: Los enemigos en llamas reciben más daño de ti, y resistes el fuego.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.hatchling_egg.2: R key: eclosiona un dragoncito que te acompaña y escupe fuego a tus enemigos.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.hatchling_egg.l: Todavía no sabe que es pequeño.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.fairy_jar.1: Velocidad para ti y tus aliados cercanos.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.fairy_jar.2: R key: liberas tres hadas que curan aliados y disparan chispas a los enemigos.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.fairy_jar.lore: Si las oyes reír, ya están de tu lado.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.moon_blade.1: De noche: velocidad; con luna llena, también fuerza.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.moon_blade.2: R key: dos cuchilladas de luna cruzan el aire y cortan todo a su paso.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.moon_blade.lore: La luna corta más hondo que cualquier acero.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.rocket_pack.1: Se recarga en el suelo; la barra muestra el combustible.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.rocket_pack.2: Mantén el clic derecho para volar con propulsión. Al soltar, caes suavemente.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.rocket_pack.lor: Huele a pólvora y a libertad.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.music_box.2: Mantén el clic derecho para darle cuerda: su nana duerme a los enemigos y calma a los aliados.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.music_box.lore: Hay melodías que no se olvidan, ni siquiera dormidos.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.star_heart.2: Mantén el clic derecho para cargar y suelta: un rayo de estrella atraviesa todo.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.star_heart.lore: Latía antes de que existiera el cielo.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.dragon_whip.1: En el Nether: fuerza y resistencia al fuego.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.dragon_whip.2: R key: un latigazo de fuego daña, prende y arrastra; agachado, restalla en círculo.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.dragon_whip.lor: Se enrosca solo cuando huele peligro.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.abyss_scepter.1: Los enemigos que te acechan por la espalda brillan.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.abyss_scepter.2: R key: tentáculos del abismo atrapan, hieren y luego aplastan a los enemigos.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.abyss_scepter.l: Lo que hay debajo también tiene hambre.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.comp_land_shark: Nada bajo la tierra y muerde desde abajo.
Nada bajo la tierra y muerde desde abajo.
Nada por el suelo como si fuera el mar: solo se le ve la aleta.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.comp_cat.1: Te da suerte y, de noche, visión nocturna.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.comp_cat.2: Te da suerte y, de noche, visión nocturna.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.comp_cat.lore: Su patita saluda… y la fortuna responde.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.comp_bunny.1: Saltas más alto y caes despacio, como en la luna.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.comp_bunny.2: Saltas más alto y caes despacio, como en la luna.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.comp_bunny.lore: Hace mochis de luz de luna cuando nadie mira.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.comp_cloud.1: Llovizna que cura, apaga tu fuego y lanza rayitos.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.comp_cloud.2: Llovizna que cura, apaga tu fuego y lanza rayitos.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.comp_cloud.lore: Llueve cuando está triste y sale el arcoíris cuando la abrazas.
Polvo de estrellas, suerte y un deseo cuando estás en apuros.
Polvo de estrellas, suerte y un deseo cuando estás en apuros.
Cayó del cielo una noche y decidió quedarse contigo.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.comp_turtle.1: Con poca vida resistes más; en el agua, respiras.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.comp_turtle.2: Con poca vida resistes más; en el agua, respiras.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.comp_turtle.lor: En su caparazón hay una isla con palmera para ti.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.comp_penguin.1: En el agua, nadas más rápido y respiras.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.comp_penguin.2: En el agua, nadas más rápido y respiras.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.comp_penguin.lo: Siempre dice que el mapa está al revés, pero llega.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.comp_astro_octo: Gravedad de la Luna y chorros de tinta que ciegan.
Gravedad de la Luna y chorros de tinta que ciegan.
Ocho brazos, un casco y muchas ganas de ver las estrellas de cerca.
crate.mundos_de_axelis.esc: Pulsa ESC para cerrar (la ruleta sigue y los demás la ven)
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.key.pets: Abre una Caja de Mascotas: te da una figurita de compañero al azar.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.key.relics: Abre una Caja de Reliquias: te da una reliquia al azar.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.key.use: Clic derecho sobre: %s. Se gasta al abrir.
message.mundos_de_axelis.crate_need_key: Necesitas la llave de este crate en la mano.
message.mundos_de_axelis.crate_empty: Este crate está vacío por ahora.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.comp_chick.1: Caes con suavidad: su sombrero hace de paracaídas.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.comp_chick.2: Caes con suavidad: su sombrero hace de paracaídas.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.comp_chick.lore: Donde se sienta, brota algo nuevo.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.comp_frog.1: Saltas más alto mientras lo llevas.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.comp_frog.2: Saltas más alto mientras lo llevas.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.comp_frog.lore: Lleva un jardín en la espalda y no le pesa.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.comp_hamster.1: Te da un caramelito cuando tienes hambre.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.comp_hamster.2: Te da un caramelito cuando tienes hambre.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.comp_hamster.lo: Stuffs so many seeds in its cheeks its smile barely fits.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.comp_snail.1: Con poca vida, su casita te cura poco a poco.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.comp_snail.2: Con poca vida, su casita te cura poco a poco.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.comp_snail.lore: Su chimenea siempre huele a pan recién hecho.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.comp_bee.1: Picas más rápido mientras la llevas.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.comp_bee.2: Picas más rápido mientras la llevas.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.comp_bee.lore: Zumba al ritmo de tu corazón.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.comp_sheep.1: Pisada firme: saltas un poco más y caes con suavidad.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.comp_sheep.2: Pisada firme: saltas un poco más y caes con suavidad.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.comp_sheep.lore: Sube montañas solo para mirarte desde arriba.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.comp_toaster.1: Lanza tostadas calientes y te prepara el desayuno.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.comp_toaster.2: Lanza tostadas calientes y te prepara el desayuno.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.comp_toaster.lo: Su sueño es hacer la tostada perfecta. Todavía se le queman un poco.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.comp_axolotl.1: In water: regeneration II, breathing, vision and dolphin grace; on land, it regenerates you at low health.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.comp_axolotl.2: In water: regeneration II, breathing, vision and dolphin grace; on land, it regenerates you at low health.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.comp_axolotl.lo: Sonríe incluso cuando todo sale mal.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.comp_vampire_ba: Ecolocalización, mordidas que roban vida y drenaje.
Ecolocalización, mordidas que roban vida y drenaje.

gui.mundos_de_axelis.pet.tip.pet: Give it some love: hearts, its happy sound and a little more affection.

gui.mundos_de_axelis.npc.title: Villager
gui.mundos_de_axelis.npc.rescued.sub: Place their House Seed next to your home: you'll see their house as a hologram
gui.mundos_de_axelis.npc.locked: Not yet: you need more residents with a house.
gui.mundos_de_axelis.npc.shop_hint: Residents with a house: %s · more residents, more goods
npc.mundos_de_axelis.ruda.preso.0: Huh? A visitor without roots on their feet. How novel.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.ruda.preso.1: I'm Ruda. A herbalist... or I was, until the Sprouts decided I looked better behind bars.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.ruda.preso.2: The Oak Dryad has the key, the spirit of this sanctuary. She used to tend the flowers... now she sleeps among roots and lets no one leave. When she wakes, stay away from her pink flowers.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.ruda.preso.3: Get me out of here and I owe you one. And I always pay my debts... almost always on time.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.ruda.preso.sin_llav: The key? Lost it? Listen... the Dryad is sprouting again among the roots, and she has it. Take it from her.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.ruda.libre.0: Air! Air that doesn't smell of wet moss. Thank you, really.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.ruda.libre.1: Take this House Seed. Plant it near where you live and I'll have a roof in no time. Don't ask how: it's advanced botany.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.ruda.libre.2: Once I have a house I'll open my stall: herbs, cures, compasses... and forest gossip, free of charge.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.ruda.libre.espera: Planted my seed yet? Find a flat, clear spot: roots are picky. I'll wait here, counting mushrooms.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.ruda.vecino.0: Welcome to my humble hut. Wipe your feet; the Sprouts never did.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.ruda.vecino.1: The Rey Brote wasn't always a tyrant. He used to be a very friendly shrub. Power corrupts, even plants.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.ruda.vecino.2: A giant smith works at the Forge. They say he keeps hammering even when nobody orders anything. Just like my cousin.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.ruda.vecino.3: The volcano roars when someone gets close to its heart. Bring fire resistance. Or a bucket. Or better yet, don't go.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.ruda.vecino.4: The Archmage's tower has more steps than I have patience. And that's saying something.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.ruda.vecino.5: Beyond the snow there's an ice citadel. Someone's locked up there too. Those places always have someone locked up.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.ruda.vecino.6: Bring more residents and I'll get better suppliers. That's how trade works... and gossip.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.ruda.vecino.7: Why did the Sprouts lock me up? Maybe because I told them they had aphids. It's true, but they didn't like it.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.ruda.kit: Here's another seed. Treat it well: it's the only house I've got.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.ruda.ya_kit: You already have my seed in your pocket. Plant it, don't collect it.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.ruda.mudanza: Done, I packed everything. The house goes back to the earth; whatever you added stays. Take the seed and pick another spot.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.ruda.mudanza.seguro: Move out? The house comes apart and you'll have to plant the seed somewhere else. Press again to confirm.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.ruda.falta_hierro: Without %s iron ingots, no lock is going anywhere. Literally.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.ruda.sin_casa: First I need a house. I don't sell anything out in the open: the dew ruins the herbs.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.ruda.hint.volcan: The roots tell me things: there's a volcano to %s, about %s blocks away. They say whoever jumps into its lake doesn't get burned. Odd, right?
npc.mundos_de_axelis.ruda.hint.bosque: There is a gigantic tree, the Great Forest Temple, to the %s, about %s blocks away. You go in between its roots and climb inside the hollow trunk: up in the crown is the Portal Stone.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.ruda.hint.none: I don't sense anything like that nearby (%s). Explore farther and ask me again.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.ruda.hint.here: %s? It's practically on top of you. Look around.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.ruda.hint.hielo: They say there's a crystal citadel to %s, about %s blocks away. Bring a coat; I'm not lending mine.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.bruno.preso.0: Finally, someone who doesn't howl or creak! Forgive me for not getting up: I haven't felt my feet in three weeks.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.bruno.preso.1: Bruno, cartographer. I came to map this outpost and the sentinels decided I was part of the furniture.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.bruno.preso.2: The sentinel guarding the dais has the key. The one with the shiny armor. Yes, the scary one.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.bruno.preso.3: Watch his sword: when he crouches and the floor creaks, back off. I know because I saw it... many times... from in here.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.bruno.preso.sin_lla: Lost the key? Another sentinel just arrived at the fort, with the key on its belt. I've already marked it on my map.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.bruno.libre.0: Free! And with all ten fingers. Thank you. With this frost on my goggles I can't see you well, but I'm sure you have a kind face.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.bruno.libre.1: Take my House Seed. Plant it somewhere the wind doesn't blow so hard and I'll have a cabin in no time. One with a chimney, please.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.bruno.libre.2: Once I'm settled I'll tell you where everything in this world is. I have maps of everything. Well, almost everything.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.bruno.libre.espera: Planted my seed yet? I'll wait here, rubbing my hands. Literally: it's to keep from freezing.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.bruno.vecino.0: Come in, come in, you're letting the cold in. Did I tell you I have a chimney? Best thing that's happened to me in years.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.bruno.vecino.1: The Arctic Wolf has guarded the Ice Palace since before I drew my first map. And I drew it when I was six.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.bruno.vecino.2: A good cartographer never gets lost. He just discovers roads nobody asked for.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.bruno.vecino.3: Ruda says my maps have more coffee stains than roads. That's a lie: they also have soup stains.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.bruno.vecino.4: If you go to the ice dungeon, dress warmly and don't run on the blue ice. I say it from experience... and from my back.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.bruno.vecino.5: There's a volcano out there that wasn't on any map. Well, now it is: I drew it, from very, very far away.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.bruno.vecino.6: With more residents I get good paper and ink that doesn't freeze. You keep rescuing people.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.bruno.vecino.7: Know why sentinels don't talk? Their tongues froze the first winter. Ever since, they just creak.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.bruno.kit: Here's another seed. This time don't use it as a paperweight.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.bruno.ya_kit: You already have my seed. Lose it again and I'll draw you a map to find it.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.bruno.mudanza: Done, I packed my maps. The cabin goes back to the earth; whatever you added stays. Take the seed and find another spot.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.bruno.mudanza.segur: Move again? My back isn't up for it... The cabin comes apart. Press again to confirm.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.bruno.falta_hierro: Without %s iron ingots this lock won't budge. It's more stubborn than me, and that's saying something.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.bruno.sin_casa: First a house with a chimney. Nobody buys maps from a shivering old man.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.bruno.hint.volcan: According to my maps there's a volcano to %s, about %s blocks away. My note says: «the entrance is the lake at the top. Jump». With a soup stain.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.bruno.hint.bosque: There is a gigantic tree, the Great Forest Temple, to the %s, about %s blocks away. Ruda says it smells of moss. I say it smells of spring.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.bruno.hint.hielo: There's a crystal citadel to %s, about %s blocks away. I drew it from afar: if it's that big up close, it won't fit on my map.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.bruno.hint.none: Nothing like that shows up nearby on my maps (%s). Explore farther and tell me, I'll draw it.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.bruno.hint.here: %s? It's right here. You don't even need a map.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.ruda.hint.forja: The roots feel a pounding to %s, about %s blocks away: it's the great foundry. Careful, the rocks walk there.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.bruno.hint.forja: The great foundry is to %s, about %s blocks away. I marked it with a soot smudge. This time it's not soup, I swear.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.hilda.preso.0: You're not slag, are you? Good. I've been locked in here for days listening to those rock heaps drag their feet.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.hilda.preso.1: Hilda, blacksmith. I was the Great Ember Smith's apprentice in this very foundry, before his fire went wild and the slag came to life.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.hilda.preso.2: The Smelter guarding the portal altar has the key. It's slow, but it hits like a drop hammer. I'd know: I helped cast it.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.hilda.preso.3: When it swells up and you see a red ring on the floor, get out of the ring. Don't think: get out. Then hit it while it cools down.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.hilda.preso.sin_lla: No key? Another smelter came down to guard the cell and it carries the key. Hit it hard: slag doesn't last long.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.hilda.libre.0: Finally! My hands went numb from gripping these bars. Thank you. I owe you one, and I always pay my debts.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.hilda.libre.1: Take my House Seed. Plant it on solid ground: a smithy isn't built on mud. And if you can, far from the slag.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.hilda.libre.2: Once I have a new workshop, come see me. With three residents in town I can get you things even the Great Smith didn't have at hand.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.hilda.libre.espera: And my smithy? My hands are idle and that puts me in a bad mood. Plant that seed.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.hilda.vecino.0: Come in, but don't touch the forge: it's hotter than it looks. Everything here is hotter than it looks.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.hilda.vecino.1: The Great Smith taught me that metal doesn't lie: if it's badly tempered, it breaks. Same goes for people.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.hilda.vecino.2: If you go to his arena, don't stand still when he raises the hammer. I saw him split an anvil in two... out of anger.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.hilda.vecino.3: Bruno brought me a map to hang on the wall. It has a soup stain right where my house is. Very flattering.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.hilda.vecino.4: Ruda asked me for pruning shears. I made her three. You never have just one good tool.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.hilda.vecino.5: Sparkers aren't evil, they're just made of loose sparks. The problem is that loose sparks burn.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.hilda.vecino.6: More residents in town means better coal, better iron... and better things for your pockets. Keep rescuing people.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.hilda.vecino.7: A blacksmith's secret? Strike when the metal is red, not white. And rest when you're the one who's red.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.hilda.kit: There's another seed. This time treat it like a good tool.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.hilda.ya_kit: You already have my seed in your pack. Check before asking: a blacksmith doesn't give anything twice.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.hilda.mudanza: Done. I packed my hammers; the smithy goes back to the earth and whatever you added stays. Take the seed and find solid ground.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.hilda.mudanza.segur: Move? I just lit the forge... The smithy comes apart. Press again if you mean it.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.hilda.falta_hierro: I need %s iron ingots to force it. Not one less: a badly forced lock jams forever.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.hilda.sin_casa: My smithy first. Without a forge I don't sell anything: I work, I don't haggle in the middle of the road.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.hilda.hint.volcan: From the smoke I'd say there's a volcano to %s, about %s blocks away. They say the crater lake is all for show: you have to jump.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.hilda.hint.bosque: There is a gigantic tree, the Great Forest Temple, to the %s, about %s blocks away. All wood and no iron. Not my thing, but it is Ruda's.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.hilda.hint.hielo: There's a crystal citadel to %s, about %s blocks away. Whoever forged its sentinels' swords had a steady hand, I'll give them that.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.hilda.hint.forja: The great foundry is to %s, about %s blocks away. If you go back, say hi to the big anvil for me. And smash a couple of slags on my behalf.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.hilda.hint.none: I don't know of any place like that around here (%s). Explore farther and come back; meanwhile I'll sharpen something.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.hilda.hint.here: %s? It's right here. Even a hammer could see it.
tooltip.mundos_de_axelis.semilla_casa.gr: Right click the seed: the house grows. If you break it, it goes back to your hand.
message.mundos_de_axelis.casa.semilla_pu: Look at the hologram: that's how %s's house will look. Right click the seed to make it grow.
message.mundos_de_axelis.casa.ocupado_n: It doesn't fit: %s blocks are in the way (shown in red in the hologram).

npc.mundos_de_axelis.ruda.hint.torre: The cherry roots speak of the Archmage's fortress to %s, about %s blocks away. It smells of ink and old magic.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.bruno.hint.torre: The Archmage's fortress is to %s, about %s blocks away. I didn't draw it very well: it kept moving. Or so I think.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.hilda.hint.torre: There's a wizard fortress to %s, about %s blocks away. Lots of books, no anvil. I don't know how they live like that.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.teo.preso.0: Ah! A person! Sorry, I've been here so long I started talking to the cobwebs. One of them is called Rosa.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.teo.preso.1: I'm Teo, this tower's librarian. Well, I was... until the Archmage decided the books were his alone.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.teo.preso.2: The enchanted armor in the observatory has the key, right at the top. Climb the spiral staircase and don't look down.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.teo.preso.3: Those armors look like statues until you get close. Then they don't look like statues anymore: they look like trouble.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.teo.preso.sin_llave: Lost the key? According to chapter four of 'Locks for the Curious', there is always a copy. The armor that just arrived has it.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.teo.libre.0: Free! Finally! The first thing I'll do is sort my books. The second, eat something that isn't dust.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.teo.libre.1: Take my House Seed. Place it wherever you like and look at the hologram: if something shows up red, it's in the way. The manual says so.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.teo.libre.2: With four residents in town I'll be able to get real books. Enchanted books, I mean. The best ones.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.teo.libre.espera: Placed my seed yet? I'll wait here, rereading the same book for the eighth time.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.teo.vecino.0: Welcome to my library! Everything is sorted by color. And by size. And by how much I like it.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.teo.vecino.1: The Archmage wrote at night in the observatory. He said the stars dictated to him. I think he just had insomnia.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.teo.vecino.2: If you go to his arena, watch the floor: before every big spell, the magic warns you.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.teo.vecino.3: Bruno lent me a map and I gave it back with a four-page review. Now he doesn't lend me anything.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.teo.vecino.4: Hilda says reading is useless. Then she asked me for a book on alloys and read it all in one night.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.teo.vecino.5: Ruda gave me a plant for my desk. I read it a chapter every morning; I think it grows faster.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.teo.vecino.6: The more residents, the more books arrive. And the more books arrive, the less room I have. It's a good problem.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.teo.vecino.7: Fun fact: haunted books don't bite. Well, almost never. Well, not me.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.teo.kit: Here's another seed. I wrote it down in my lending log, so take care of it.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.teo.ya_kit: You already have my seed. According to my log, you've had it for a while. Check your pack.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.teo.mudanza: Done, I boxed up my books. The house goes back to the earth and whatever you added stays. Take the seed and find another spot.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.teo.mudanza.seguro: Move? I'd have to sort everything again... The house comes apart. Press again if you really want to.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.teo.falta_hierro: It takes %s iron ingots. The book says so, and books don't lie. Almost never.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.teo.sin_casa: A house first, please. I can't sell anything while my books sleep on the grass.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.teo.hint.volcan: According to my notes there's a volcano to %s, about %s blocks away. A book says the door is the crater lake: you have to jump.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.teo.hint.bosque: There is a gigantic tree, the Great Forest Temple, to the %s, about %s blocks away. There is a library inside the trunk. Inside a tree!
npc.mundos_de_axelis.teo.hint.hielo: There's a crystal citadel to %s, about %s blocks away. According to my books, there's a frozen crypt beneath it.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.teo.hint.forja: The great foundry is to %s, about %s blocks away. Hilda says you can hear the hammer there even when nobody's around.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.teo.hint.torre: The Archmage's fortress is to %s, about %s blocks away. They kept me prisoner there. If you see books, bring them to me. Please.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.teo.hint.none: I have nothing written down about that around here (%s). Explore farther and tell me later: I'll take notes.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.teo.hint.here: %s? It's right here! Even I can see it, and I need glasses.
message.mundos_de_axelis.volcan.regreso: The Return Stone takes you back to the volcano's entrance.
message.mundos_de_axelis.volcan.regreso_: This stone can't find its volcano.
Right-click the Return Stone (next to the altar) to leave the volcano.
message.mundos_de_axelis.volcan.salta_pi: This heat doesn't burn... The cultists used to jump into the lake. What if the lava is fake?
npc.mundos_de_axelis.ignacio.preso.0: Don't hurt me! I'm not one of them anymore... My name is Ignacio. I used to serve the volcano; now I just want out.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.ignacio.preso.1: I told them I was leaving the cult and they locked me up «to think it over». I've been thinking for months. I still want to leave.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.ignacio.preso.2: The high priest has the key, the one praying by the heart's altar. He won't leave it even to eat.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.ignacio.preso.3: When you leave, use the Return Stone next to the altar: it takes you to the entrance. The lake only goes down, brother. Sorry: friend.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.ignacio.preso.sin_l: No key? The cultists have copies of everything. Another one just arrived with the key on its belt. Be careful.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.ignacio.libre.0: Free! Thank you, thank you... I swear I'll never wear a robe again. Well, this one, I don't have another.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.ignacio.libre.1: Take my House Seed. Put it in your village and check the hologram first: I want a sunny spot for my flowers.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.ignacio.libre.2: With five neighbours I can bring things from the volcano without getting burned: blaze rods and an apple that shines a lot.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.ignacio.libre.esper: Did you plant my seed yet? I'll wait here. Away from the lake, if you don't mind.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.ignacio.vecino.0: Welcome to my hermitage! I used to worship fire; now I water daisies. Daisies don't ask for sacrifices.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.ignacio.vecino.1: The Great Salamander heals in real lava. Lure it onto solid ground and you'll see how fast it tires.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.ignacio.vecino.2: The four braziers in the eruption hall open the treasure room. Light them all. I know because I used to put them out.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.ignacio.vecino.3: Ruda is teaching me to make tea. Chamomile calms me down. Nettle makes me cry, but she says that's normal.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.ignacio.vecino.4: Hilda says mine is the only campfire that doesn't scare her. I think that's a compliment.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.ignacio.vecino.5: Bruno wants to map the inside of the volcano. I told him to jump into the lake. He gave me a weird look. It was real advice.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.ignacio.vecino.6: Teo lent me a book: «How to Leave a Cult and Make Friends». A bit late, but I'm reading it anyway.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.ignacio.vecino.7: When something scares me, I plant a flower. I have a pretty big garden by now, honestly.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.ignacio.kit: Here's another seed. Don't throw this one in the lake, okay? That only works with people.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.ignacio.ya_kit: You already have my seed, brother. Sorry: friend. Check your backpack.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.ignacio.mudanza: Done. I packed my flowerpots; the hermitage goes back to the earth and what you built stays. Take the seed and find another sunny spot.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.ignacio.mudanza.seg: Move? My flowers just took root... The house comes apart. Press again if you really mean it.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.ignacio.falta_hierr: It takes %s iron ingots. Sorry: those locks are cheap, but not that cheap.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.ignacio.sin_casa: My house first, please. I can't sell anything sleeping outdoors: it reminds me of the cell.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.ignacio.hint.volcan: The volcano is to %s, about %s blocks away. You get in by jumping into the crater lake and out with the Return Stone.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.ignacio.hint.bosque: There is a gigantic tree, the Great Forest Temple, to the %s, about %s blocks away. Ruda says everything grows there. Even courage, I guess.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.ignacio.hint.hielo: There's a crystal citadel to %s, about %s blocks away. Cold, very cold. The opposite of what I knew.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.ignacio.hint.forja: The great foundry is to %s, about %s blocks away. There they use fire to work, not to scare people.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.ignacio.hint.torre: The Archmage's fortress is to %s, about %s blocks away. Teo says it has more books than stones.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.ignacio.hint.none: I don't know of anything like that nearby (%s). I used to know only the volcano... Explore further.
npc.mundos_de_axelis.ignacio.hint.here: %s? It's right here! Even I can see it, and I spent years looking only at lava.

lore.mundos_de_axelis.bosque_1.title: The First Sprout
lore.mundos_de_axelis.bosque_1.p1: Nobody planted the Sprout King. It fell from the sky on a stormy night, like a burning seed, in the courtyard of the old temple.
lore.mundos_de_axelis.bosque_1.p2: By morning moss covered the stairs and the first Sprouts hopped between the statues. The monks left. The forest stayed.
lore.mundos_de_axelis.bosque_2.title: The Herbalist and the Dryad
lore.mundos_de_axelis.bosque_2.p1: Ruda came to the sanctuary looking for moonroot. The Sprouts let her in: she smelled of wet soil.
lore.mundos_de_axelis.bosque_2.p2: But the Oak Dryad, the sanctuary's spirit soured by the corruption, decided that someone who knows plants so well must never leave. She locked her behind the moss and fell asleep among the roots, with the key.
lore.mundos_de_axelis.bosque_3.title: The World Tree
lore.mundos_de_axelis.bosque_3.p1: In the crown of the World Tree, above all its branches, the Portal Stone beats like a green heart.
lore.mundos_de_axelis.bosque_3.p2: They say whoever touches it hears the Sprout King: "Defeat my roots and the seal will fall." Those who tried before they were ready are now fertilizer.
lore.mundos_de_axelis.forja_1.title: The Fire That Went Mad
lore.mundos_de_axelis.forja_1.p1: The Great Ember Smith forged bells for the whole kingdom. One day he threw into the crucible a metal not of this world.
lore.mundos_de_axelis.forja_1.p2: The fire turned red, then green, then a color with no name. Ever since, the slag crawls on its own through the Great Foundry.
lore.mundos_de_axelis.forja_2.title: The Sleeping Colossus
lore.mundos_de_axelis.forja_2.p1: To guard his treasure, the Great Smith cast an iron giant and lit a furnace in its chest. He called it the Colossus.
lore.mundos_de_axelis.forja_2.p2: The Colossus sleeps standing in the Forgotten Forge and wakes if it hears footsteps. Hilda's advice: when it pounds the ground, jump.
lore.mundos_de_axelis.forja_3.title: The Apprentice
lore.mundos_de_axelis.forja_3.p1: Hilda was the Great Smith's last apprentice. When the fire went mad, she tried to put it out with snow water.
lore.mundos_de_axelis.forja_3.p2: The Founder caught her first. From the cell by the lava lake, Hilda still counts the hammer blows: one, two... and the slag creaks.
lore.mundos_de_axelis.hielo_1.title: The Crystal Citadel
lore.mundos_de_axelis.hielo_1.p1: The frost queen had a citadel of quartz and ice raised so that winter would never end.
lore.mundos_de_axelis.hielo_1.p2: When she died, nobody turned off the cold. Her sentinels still walk their rounds, though there is no one left to protect.
lore.mundos_de_axelis.hielo_2.title: The Last Sentinel
lore.mundos_de_axelis.hielo_2.p1: Bruno says one sentinel refused to sleep when the queen died. It stayed on the dais, by the map table.
lore.mundos_de_axelis.hielo_2.p2: Its companions turned into frost statues. It did not. It waits for someone to tell it the watch is over.
lore.mundos_de_axelis.hielo_3.title: The Arctic Wolf's Howl
lore.mundos_de_axelis.hielo_3.p1: Beneath the citadel, in the frozen crypt, the Portal Stone guards the way to the Arctic Wolf's palace.
lore.mundos_de_axelis.hielo_3.p2: The frost wolves are its cubs. If you hear them all howl at once, it isn't the wind: it's the Wolf, and it knows you are coming.
lore.mundos_de_axelis.fuego_1.title: The Volcano Cult
lore.mundos_de_axelis.fuego_1.p1: The cultists believe the volcano is a sleeping heart and that, if it beats, the whole world will burn. So they pray to it.
lore.mundos_de_axelis.fuego_1.p2: Ignacio believed it for years. One day he planted a poppy by the altar and saw the fire didn't burn it. That day he began to doubt.
lore.mundos_de_axelis.fuego_2.title: The Leap of Faith
lore.mundos_de_axelis.fuego_2.p1: "Fire does not burn those who believe," says the sign at the crater. It's half true: the lake's lava is fake, a trick of the high priest.
lore.mundos_de_axelis.fuego_2.p2: Everything else does burn. That's why the cultists jump... and thieves prefer to climb down the slope.
lore.mundos_de_axelis.fuego_3.title: The Magma Heart
lore.mundos_de_axelis.fuego_3.p1: In the depths of the volcano hangs the Magma Heart, bound with chains the Great Smith forged before he went mad.
lore.mundos_de_axelis.fuego_3.p2: If they break, the heart awakens. The high priest keeps the key to the cell of the only one who tried to stop it: Ignacio.
lore.mundos_de_axelis.magia_1.title: The Archmage
lore.mundos_de_axelis.magia_1.p1: The Archmage was once a student of this tower. He read every book in the library and then decided no one else should.
lore.mundos_de_axelis.magia_1.p2: He enchanted the armors to guard the halls and the books to bite. The librarian he locked in the crypt.
lore.mundos_de_axelis.magia_2.title: Teo and Rosa the Spider
lore.mundos_de_axelis.magia_2.p1: Teo the librarian survived in the crypt by sorting the tower's books from memory, by author and by color.
lore.mundos_de_axelis.magia_2.p2: His only company was a spider he named Rosa. Teo swears Rosa wove better than the Archmage cast spells.
lore.mundos_de_axelis.magia_3.title: The Observatory
lore.mundos_de_axelis.magia_3.p1: At the top of the Fortress, under the dome, the Portal Stone gazes at the stars. The Archmage uses it to reach his peak.
lore.mundos_de_axelis.magia_3.p2: From there he reshapes the sky at will. Those who came back say the stars moved... and that one of them was watching.

libro.mundos_de_axelis.gemas.1:
Gems give powers to your weapons and armor.
Everything happens at the Gem Table: infuse, combine, socket and remove.

Turn the page.
libro.mundos_de_axelis.gemas.2:
They come from chests, barrels, elites, Looters and tasks.
Their purity depends on the tier:
1-2 Cracked
3-4 Cut
5-6 Polished
7-8 Perfect
libro.mundos_de_axelis.gemas.3:
Each element has its essence. They drop from elites, tasks and chests of their tier:
1 Poison · 2 Edge
3 Frost · 4 Fire
5 Arcane · 6 Vampire
7 Lightning · 8 Void
libro.mundos_de_axelis.gemas.4:
Put an empty gem and an essence: you get a gem of that element with the same purity.

It costs 20 ◆ per purity level.
libro.mundos_de_axelis.gemas.5:
Three equal gems (same element and purity, or three empty ones) fuse into one of the next purity.

It costs 30 ◆ per level. Perfect is the best.
libro.mundos_de_axelis.gemas.6:
Put a weapon (swords, axes, tridents and the new weapons) or an armor piece and a gem.
One gem per piece.
Removing it costs 15 ◆ and gives it back.
libro.mundos_de_axelis.gemas.7:
Each purity level makes the effect stronger.
On armor, the gems of every piece add up.

Next pages: what each element does.
libro.mundos_de_axelis.gemas.fin:
· Keep low-tier empty gems to combine them.
· A Void gem in every piece gives a lot of health.
· If you lose this guide, craft it at the Artificer's Table.
